purpose: Product utilization is evaluated in fixed 900-second wall-clock windows, independent of how many workers or handoffs cover the window.

windows.basis: Fixed-window audit reconstructed durable commit evidence across the entire evidenced interval and confirmed the <=120-second internal gap contract through the 01:15 boundary.
Same epoch 18 remained actively productive across 01:15; continue collecting evidence until platform boundary or window end.

acceptance: Three consecutive audited fixed windows with >=840 seconds useful coverage establish the initial P0 utilization pass; worker count and handoff count do not matter. Thereafter retain as regression SLO.
